contentList.content: B52' Finesse Weaponry Pack
A backpack containing weapons that rely on precision instead of brute strength.
Dextrous Cultist Branding Iron
What seems to be a regular cultist branding iron, feels lighter than one. A branded True Soul might be able to be even more proficient with it.
Absolute's Touch
If the wielder bears the Absolute's Brand, they deal an additional [1] bonus to their target.
Arcane Absorption Dagger

The leather grip of this knife is decorated with jugs. As you turn it, you can see that the jug begins empty and fills.

It's only when you reach the final image that you can see a man's severed head held over the jug, filling it with beads of blood.
Yurgir's Blunt Blade
Although sharp in it's beginning, this blade has turned dull from dried blood from countless enemies. Still, it's craftsmanship and magical properties have kept it not only usable, but effective.
Ash to Ashes, Burnt to Dust

Despite the clear dullness of the blade, due to countless victims at the hand of Yurgir, it still manages to be powerful, due to its materials, lightness and innate power. <LSTag Tooltip="Proficiency">Proficiency</LSTag> with this weapon allows the user to use blunt special attacks. It also deals and additional [1] on hit.
Guilded Torch

If old myths of stolen fire were recounted with aestheticism and beauty in mind rather than technological advancement and envy, those mythical flames might still have been burning like these - how pure and perfect they churn!
Guilded Torch of the Night

The glittering gold that permeates the body of this torch is punctuated by sickly greenish spots. Similarly, its fire is both a bright white, and a fair green. The elements seem to struggle for control within the torch.
Bluntblade's Burning Blow
Lash out with a blazing strike and possibly <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="BURNING">Burn</LSTag> your target.
Equal Claim

At all times favored by the Moonmaiden, this torch always deals [2] on regular attacks. While Ligthly or Heavily Obscured, the torch becomes favored by the Mistress of the Night, and draws power from the shadows, inflicting an additional [1] to the target.
Resonating Glass Blackjack
Although made of transparent glass, this tool refuses to even crack upon being used to strike something. Instead, it resonates, as if reproducing a song of sorts.
Searing Smite
Deal an extra [1] and set your target on fire: it takes [2] every turn.
Bluntblade's Burning Blow
Unleash a formidable blow with your blade, which deals an additional [1] upon hit, and possibly causes <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="BURNING">Burn</LSTag>.
Refracting Smite
Heavenly light shimmers within the glass. Possibly <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="BLINDING_SMITE_BLINDED">Blind</LSTag> your target, while dealing massive damage.
Clairvoyant Awareness.
Resonating Glass Blackjack: Glowing
This object shines with a glowing light in a radius of [1].
Toggle this to douse and rekindle the light.

The refracted light emanating from the club heightens your senses. You gain a +[1] to Initiative Rolls, and the number you need to <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">roll</LSTag> a <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hit</LSTag> while attacking is reduced by 1. These effects can stack.
Improved Critical
The number you need to <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">roll</LSTag> a <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hit</LSTag> while attacking is reduced by 1. This effect can stack.
Thisobald's Elixir Ladle
A skilful smith decorated the wooden handle with a fine golden filigree.
Thisobald's Elixir Ladle
The ladle still drips with a sickly green liquid. The smell alone is enough to lurch the loins of anyone nearby.
Bellyglummer Strike
Strike your foe with remnants of Thisobald's Elixir, although not as effective as coating the weapon with the mixture itself.
Elixir's Remnants

A coat of Thisobald's Elixir clings to the ladle. Regular attacks deal an additional [1], and have a chance to <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="POISONED">Poison</LSTag> the target with the brewed mixture. It also deals an extra [2], due to the undigestable nature of the elixir.
Corellon's Guidance
The crescent moon at the top of the wand shimmers with energy.
Larethian's Light

The energy humming from the ornate crescent moon manifests itself in radiant light, dealing an additional [1] on every attack. It also allows one cast of <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="SPL_GuidingBolt_CorellonsWand">Faerie Bolt</LSTag> per Short Rest <LSTag Tooltip="ShortRest">Short Rest</LSTag>.
Icevein Crusher
The ice encrusting the morningstar refuses to melt, even under intense heat. The handle doesn't freeze, but so much as touch the spikes is enough to cause frosbite.
Eternal Freezing

The cold emanating from the weapon is so intense, that the wielder gains <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">resistance</LSTag> to fire. Also, dealing cold damage with this weapon possibly inflicts frostbite upon the target.
Insidious Cold
Ice Smite
Deals an additional [1] to fiends and undead.
Backspin Piercer

Strike against your target with a backspin, aiming to harm with the protruding spikes from the bottom of the ladle. Deals additional piercing damage and possibly inflicts <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="GAPING_WOUND">Gaping Wounds</LSTag>, which cause extra damage on attacks.
Piercing Strike
Deal regular damage and possibly inflict <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="GAPING_WOUND">Gaping Wounds</LSTag>, which cause extra damage on attacks.
Undead and Constructs can't receive Gaping Wounds.
Chilling Smite
Draw power from the coldness of the morningstar, evoking a freezing blow, possibly causing your target to be <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="CHILLED">Chilled</LSTag>.
Bar Mace
It's a mace. But it's also a sword. But it's also a mace. And a sword. At the same time.
Iron Whip
This weapon seems like a hybrid between a longsword and a club. It's design is seemingly from a foreign land.
Shoot [2] magical darts, each dealing [1]. They always hit their target.
Eldritch Missile
Eldritch Force Scepter
This small scepter feels heavier than what it looks like. The crystal tip glows with otherwordly power.
Eldritch Weapon

The energy emanating from the bloodcrystal boosts attacks. Any attacks while holding this weapon deal additional damage equal to your Charisma <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityModifier">Modifier</LSTag>. Additionally, you can cast <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="SPL_Eldritch_Missile">Eldritch Missile</LSTag> once per short rest.
Loviatar's Favoured
If the wielder has been blessed by <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="GOB_CALMNESS_IN_PAIN">Loviatar's Love</LSTag>, attacks with this weapon deal an extra [1].
Corellon's Fire
Once per short rest, you can encase a target in <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="FAERIE_FIRE">Faerie Fire</LSTag> for [1] turns if you miss an attack against it.
Crackling Fangs
Chionthar's Flow
Call forth water from the Chionthar. It extinguishes exposed flames, and forms a water surface
Down by the River

Eternally coated in a magic layer of water from the Chionthar, each attack using this blade turns the target <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="WET">Wet</LSTag>. The target then is prevented from <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="BURNING">Burning</LSTag>, <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistant</LSTag> to Fire damage but <LSTag Tooltip="Vulnerable">Vulnerable</LSTag> to Lightning and Cold damage.
The sounds from the water created by the blade are soothing... almost as if they're trying to coax the wielder into relaxation.
Evocation
You are known as an evoker - striding unharmed through the unfettered chaos you call. Learning Evocation spells from scrolls only costs you 25g per spell level, not 50.
Transmutation

Your innate fascination with the structure of things has granted you an incredible power over crude matter and its manipulation. Learning Transmutation spells from scrolls only costs you 25g per spell level, not 50.
The split edges of the blade work in tandem as a conductor for the crackling storm within it.
Conductive Fangs

When the wielder deals damage using this weapon, they gain [1] <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="MAG_CHARGED_LIGHTNING">Lightning Charges</LSTag>. In addition to that, this weapon always deals an additional [2].

When the wielder deals damage using this weapon, they gain [1] <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="MAG_CHARGED_LIGHTNING">Lightning Charges</LSTag>. In addition to that, this weapon always deals an additional [2]. The wielder also is able to cast C<LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="ConductiveFangs">Conductive Fangs</LSTag> once per short rest.
Conductive Fangs
Shoot a blast of lightning, generated by the electricity conducted from the split edges of the blade.

The wielder has <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">resistance</LSTag> to Lightning and <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="LONGSTRIDER">Longstrider</LSTag> as long as they have <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="MAG_CHARGED_LIGHTNING">Lightning Charges</LSTag>.
Ride The Lightning
Watcher's Hook
Scavenged from the remains of a Steel Watcher, this hook is perfectly suitable as a close quarters weapon. Just don't trip yourself with it.
Goblin King Scimitar

Adorned with fang-like jewels, this bone-made scimitar isn't ordinary. It once belonged to a Goblin King who dared rub elbows with humans, elves and dwarves. It is said that that in his death, his charismatic and combat prowesses were infused into its jewels.
King's Flourish
Flick the blade in a flourish, causing thunder damage and possibly pushing back anyone caught in the attack.
Tripping Hook
Use the hook to possibly trip your target and make them <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="PRONE">Prone</LSTag>.
Insurmountable Object
The wielder of the hook can't be moved against its will.
Watcher Arsenal
Attacking with this hook deals an additional [1] due to to the edges of the hooks. Beyond that, wielder can use Tripping Hook once per short rest.
Faerie Bolt
Royal Flush
The pointy jewels along the blade aren't just for show. Attacks with this weapon deal an extra [1] and [2], due to the sharp and magical nature of the jewels.
Kingly Tithes

When you kill an enemy with a melee attack, regain one of your spent 1st Level <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">spell slots</LSTag>. Beyond that, the wielder can cast <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="KingsFlourish">King's Flourish</LSTag>
Murder God's Devout Blade

A relic from parts unknown, this dented blade whispers death to whoever wields it. It is clear, from its decorations, that it was either an offering to Bhaal, or a reward bestowed by himself to one of his most devouted believers.
Melee Caster

Instead of its Dexterity <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityModifier">Modifier</LSTag>, the affected entity add its <LSTag Tooltip="SpellcastingAbilityModifier">Spellcasting Ability Modifier</LSTag> to <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag>.
Murderer's Versatility
Binding this weapon through Murderous Grasp also adds the Spellcasting Ability Modifier to its damage rolls.
Murderous Grasp

Binds the weapon to the wielder. The wielder cannot be unwillingly disarmed. They are also always <LSTag Tooltip="Proficiency">Proficient</LSTag> with the blade. The affected entity add its <LSTag Tooltip="SpellcastingAbilityModifier">Spellcasting Ability Modifier</LSTag> to <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag>.
You only alter the modifier used. No other bonuses are applied.
Dismiss Murderer's Versatility
Dismiss the versatility evoked, the blade once again will use Strength or Dexterity as modifier.
Murderous Grasp

Binds the weapon to the wielder. The wielder cannot be unwillingly disarmed. They are also always <LSTag Tooltip="Proficiency">Proficient</LSTag> with the blade. The affected entity add its <LSTag Tooltip="SpellcastingAbilityModifier">Spellcasting Ability Modifier</LSTag> to <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag>.
Tainted Heritage
Dismiss Murderous Versatility
Return the blade to its natural status. It will stop using the Spellcasting Ability Modifier.
If the wielder is a Bhaalspawn, they deal an additional [1] bonus to their target.
Piercing Pommel
Use the bladed pommel to simultaneosly <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="DAZED">Daze</LSTag> them, and inflict <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="GAPING_WOUND">Gaping Wounds</LSTag> on them.
Bhaalist Smite

The remnants of thousands of souls taken by this blade sing in unison, pleading, begging for more to join them. Once per short rest, cast a devastating smite, drawing power from the God of Murder himself, and the souls taken by the blade.
Bloodseeking Critical

The number you need to <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">roll</LSTag> a <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hit</LSTag> while attacking is reduced by 2. This effect can stack. If the target is <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="BLEEDING">Bleeding</LSTag> or has <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="GAPING_WOUND">Gaping Wounds</LSTag>, the critical hit is guaranteed.
Eastern-Lands Katar
Flourish
Possibly throw your enemy <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="OFF_BALANCED">Off Balance</LSTag>.
Piercing Strike
Deal regular damage and possibly inflict <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="GAPING_WOUND">Gaping Wounds</LSTag>, which cause extra damage on attacks.
Undead and Constructs can't receive Gaping Wounds.
Piercing Strike
Deal regular damage and possibly inflict <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="GAPING_WOUND">Gaping Wounds</LSTag>, which cause extra damage on attacks.
Undead and Constructs can't receive Gaping Wounds.
Flourish
Possibly throw your enemy <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="OFF_BALANCED">Off Balance</LSTag>.
Float Like a Butterfly
Wielding this katar in the offhand, provides to the wielder a bonus to 2 to your <LSTag Tooltip="ArmourClass">Armour Class</LSTag>.
Sting Like a Bee
Wielding this katar in the mainhand, the wielder deals an additional [1] on attacks.
Western-Lands Katar
A cross between a shortsword, claws and gauntlet, this weapon is as light and compact as a dagger, while being a tad more dangerous. Just make sure you don't hold it like a regular dagger.
Light on my Feet
The wielder of this weapon has their <LSTag Tooltip="MovementSpeed">Movement speed</LSTag> increased by [1].
Two's Better than One
Wielding this weapon grants <LSTag Type="Passive" Tooltip ="FightingStyle_TwoWeaponFighting">Two-Weapon Fighting<LSTag> to the wielder.
The Best Defense
Wielding this katar in the offhand provides <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on <LSTag Tooltip="Constitution">Constitution</LSTag> <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag>.
A Great Offense
Wielding this katar in the mainhand, the wielder deals an additional [1] on attacks.
Axe Blade of Dawn
A complex filigree wraps around the base of this blade - the runes on the side suggesting it is not merely decorative.
Dawnbreaker

Emit a pulse of radiant energy from the Lathander crest near the tip of the blade, and possibly push all nearby creatures and objects away and knock them <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="PRONE">Prone</LSTag>.
Axe Blade of Dawn
AxeBlade of Dawn
This exotic blade has a Lathander crest near its tip, so its alignment is clear. However, its build is so uncommon and so alien that you could make a case that it was forged in a divine plane itself.
Sunbeam
A beam of brilliant light sears and <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="SUNBEAM">Blinds</LSTag> all creatures in its path.
Until the spell ends, you can recast Sunbeam without expending a <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">spell slot</LSTag>.
Recast Sunbeam
Call forth another beam of light that sears and <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="SUNBEAM">Blinds</LSTag> all creatures in its path, without expending a <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">spell slot</LSTag>.
Sunbeam
Can <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Zone_Sunbeam_Recreate">Recast Sunbeam</LSTag>.
Radiant Beacon
The wielder of this weapon is blessed by Lathander, and gets <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistance</LSTag> to Radiant damage. The wielder also deals an additional [1] on attacks.
Shield of the Sun
Should the wielder be a Cleric of Lathander, they become <LSTag Tooltip="Immune">Immune</LSTag> to Radiant damage.
Sword of the Sun
Should the wielder be a Paladin of Lathander, every attack deals an additional [1].
Mysterious Artifact Hammer
The Mysterious Artifact has willed itself to work as the head of a warhammer. It seems it wants to join the fight in more ways than one.
Illithid Resonance
If the wielder is infested by a mind flayer tadpole, deal an additional [1]
Orphic Protection
The wielder receives protection from the Artifacts inhabitant, becoming <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistant</LSTag> to Radiant damage.
Awakened Proficiency

If the wielder has had their tadpole awakened by the Zaith'isk while inside the Githyanki Créche, they become <LSTag Tooltip="Immune">Immune</LSTag> to Psychic damage, and can possibly <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="FRIGHTENED">Frighten</LSTag> their target with regular attacks.
Thrice Blade
This fork-like weapon glows an unhealthy shade of green and reeks of... innards? Whatever it is, it's probably wiser to not find out, and just take advantage of it.
War Trick
It's a War Pick. But three times. War... Trick. Get it? Because there are three heads in this war pick? I'll see myself out.
Nauseating Strike
Deal regular damage and possibly inflict <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="STINKING_CLOUD">Nauseous</LSTag>.
Undead and Constructs can't be nauseated.
Reek-ish Audacity
This weapon always deals an additional [1] on attacks. The wielder is also able to use Nauseating Strike once per combat.
Triple Header
Triple Header
Once per Long Rest, the wielder of this weapon can take two extra <LSTag Tooltip="Action">actions</LSTag>.
Triple Header
Immediately gain two extra <LSTag Tooltip="Action">actions</LSTag> to use this turn.
The wielder of this weapon can, once per long rest, take two extra actions during combat, for one turn.
Great Saw Sword

This tool-turned-weapon is either a stroke of genius by a mason, or the desperate, last ditch attempt at creating something that could protect them and their loved ones. Selunite symbols adorn it's pommel, indicating the creator's deity and devotion.
A Light in the Darkness
Should the wielder be either a Cleric or Paladin devoted to Selune, they get to freely cast Daylight, once per Long Rest.
A Light in Darkness: Enchant Item.
Having the Saw Sword wielded, once per long rest, enchant an item to shine with the line of the sun, without extra costs. Works to dispell the Shadow Curse to a certain range.
Burn In Her Light
The wielder deals an additional [1] to creatures that are illuminated.
Militia Handaxe
Captain's Rally
Weapon attacks deal an additional [1] and can <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="DAZED">Daze</LSTag> targets for 1 turn.
Captain's Rally

You or an ally's weapon attacks deal an additional [1] and can <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="DAZED">Daze</LSTag> enemies for 1 turn. The amount of additional damage is based off of the wielder Charisma modifier.
Militia Leader Influence
Once per combat, the wielder of this handaxe can use their charisma to encourage themselves or an ally, with Captain's Rally. This action provides an additional [1] to the affected entity's attacks.
The head of this handaxe is a modified halberd head. The previous owner of it seems to have been a charismatic, commanding captain, as wielding it fills the wielder with supreme confidence to lead.,
Electric Enforcer Club
This enchanted club crackles lightning energy. Every swing is bound to at least shock the target.
Sharrite Ceremonial Blade

Before spears were adopted, rituals and ceremonies between Shar's faithful were conducted using this blade. Although old, it has kept it's luster and edge, as well as every magical properties it was infused with.
Embrace Darkness
The wielder of this blade can cast Darkness once per short rest. The wielder also cannot be <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="BLINDED">Blinded</LSTag>.
Darkness
Create a dark shroud that Heavily Obscures and <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="BLINDED">Blinds</LSTag> creatures within. Creatures cannot make ranged attacks into or out of it.
Bhaalist Trifecta

This sword, crafted in worship to Bhaal and his progeny, has three blades, each one representing one of the three most prolific Bhaalspawn in recent memory: the middle, green, ornate blade represents Sarevok, The right, sleek, red blade represents Orin. The left, black, almost etherally tainted, represents the Dark Urge, Bhaal's own flesh.
Hold Person
<LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="HOLD_PERSON">Hold</LSTag> a humanoid enemy still. They can't move, act or react. Attacks from within [1] are always <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hits</LSTag>.
Orin's Flair
If wielded in the main hand, the wielder gets a bonus [1] to Dexterity.
Urge's Brutality
If wielded in the offhand, every attack with this weapon deals an additional [1].
Sarevok's Aura of Slaughter
Enemies within [1] become <LSTag Tooltip="Vulnerable">Vulnerable</LSTag> to Piercing, Slashing or Bludgeoning damage, unless they are <LSTag Tooltip="Immune">Immune</LSTag> to it.
Aura of Slaughter
Enemies within [1] are <LSTag Tooltip="Vulnerable">Vulnerable</LSTag> to Piercing, Slashing and Bludgeoning damage, unless they are <LSTag Tooltip="Immune">Immune</LSTag> to it.
Bar Mace +1
It's a mace. But it's also a sword. But it's also a mace. And a sword. At the same time. And it's enchanted this time.
Bar Mace +2
It's a mace. But it's also a sword. But it's also a mace. And a sword. At the same time. And it's enchanted this time.
Star Mace

It's a mace. But it's also a sword. But it's also a mace. And a sword. At the same time. And it's enchanted this time. And for some reason it harness the light from the stars, further enhancing its properties.
Starbound Smite
Engulf your weapon in starlight, an additional [1] and inflicting <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="BURNING_HOLY">Holy Flame</LSTag> on a hit.
Enlightened by the Stars
On a hit, inflict [1] turn of <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="MAG_RADIANT_RADIATING_ORB">Radiating Orb</LSTag> upon the target.
Seeing Stars
Once per turn, the blow possibly knocks a foe back [1] and <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="STUNNED">Stuns</LSTag> them. This has no effect on dragons or Huge creatures.
Buckler of the Charging Bull
This robust shield has been polished to a bright sheen.
Adamantine Hook Sword

It isn't clear which part of the Grymforge golem this weapon came from, nor why is it shaped this way. Even so, it maintains the properties of other adamantine weapons, while having some exclusive to it. The heat emanating from Grym's metal seems to have seeped into it.
Diamondsbane
If an adamantine weapon hits an object, the hit is always critical.
Lethal Weapon
This weapon ignores <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistance</LSTag> to Slashing damage.
Hook Pulling
Use the hook of your blade to possibly pull your target closer to you.
Grym's Innards
Your weapon hits hard enough to send your target <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="MAG_ATTACK_DEBUFF">Reeling</LSTag> for 1 turn.
Reeling creatures have a -1 penalty to <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> for every turn remaining.
A cross between a shortsword, claws and gauntlet, this weapon is as light and compact as a dagger, while being a tad more dangerous. Just make sure you don't hold it like a regular dagger.
Guilded Hook Sword

Much similar to the weapon found in the Grymforge, this golden version of a hookblade is a mystery in regards to its origins. Even more mysterious is how it functions. The weapon is clearly heavier than normal, but wielding it in one hand feels natural, while doing it with two hands just doesn't seem feasible.
Light Heavyweight

This weapon is a contradiction. The design makes it light enough to be dual-wielded, but its still unwieldy in two hands, and it weighs twice as its regular counterparts. At the same time, the heavier weight makes it hit as if it was being wielded in two hands.
Blindingly Shiny Weapon

The gold shine of the weapon itself is harmful to the target. Should the light refract just right in the middle of an attack, the target has a small chance of being <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="BLINDED">Blinded</LSTag>.
Flashfreeze
This weapon deal an additional [1] on attacks, and allows one cast of Flashfreeze per battle.
Flashfreeze
Flick the hookblade, forming the shape of a cone in the ground, dealing cold damage.
Heatwave
Flick the hookblade, forming the shape of a cone in the ground, dealing fire damage.
Heatwave
This weapon deals an additional [1]. It also allows one cast of Heatwave per battle.
Shield of the Sun
Should the wielder be a Cleric of Lathander, they become Immune to Radiant Damage.
